en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. My father and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan narrated to me from Ḥusain ibn Ḥasan ibn Abān, from Ḥusain ibn Sa’īd, from Ibn Abī ‘Umayr, from Ḥammād ibn ‘Uthmān, from Al-Ḥalabi, who said:
I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) about the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Imam (a.s.) said, “(Go) once a year because I do not want you to be identified.”
